sources.title: Smart Banking Intent Classification & AI Keyboard ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: A two-in-one NLP project: an intent classifier that reads a banking question and tells you what the customer actually wants, and an AI keyboard that predicts the next word as you type — trained entirely on real banking language (Banking77).

sources.title: Benchmark: Intent classification (Banking77) | Aito API v2
sources.snippet: Aito on Banking77 — 77-way fine-grained banking intent classification: ~79% top-1 accuracy on the full test set with zero training, in honest context against fine-tuned transformer sentence-encoders.
